slogan.SL: Premišljeno pohištvo in svetila za prostore, v katerih je prijetno živeti. Oblikujemo v Ljubljani, izdelujemo v majhnih evropskih delavnicah in dostavljamo po vsej EU.
slogan.EN: Thoughtful furniture and lighting for spaces that feel good to live in. Designed in Ljubljana, made by small European workshops, and delivered across the EU.

note.SL: Za osebno svetovanje, ogled materialov ali prevzem večjih naročil priporočamo predhodno rezervacijo termina. Ob praznikih in med kolektivnim dopustom je razstavni salon lahko zaprt.
note.EN: For personal consultations, material reviews, or collection of larger orders, we recommend booking an appointment in advance. The showroom may be closed on public holidays and during our annual studio break.

text.SL: NORD Atelier je neodvisen oblikovalski studio in spletna trgovina za pohištvo, svetila ter premišljene dodatke za dom. Združujemo mirno severnjaško estetiko, lokalno obrtniško znanje in materiale, izbrane za dolgo življenjsko dobo. Vsak izdelek razvijamo tako, da je prijeten za uporabo, enostaven za vzdrževanje in dovolj značilen, da prostoru doda identiteto.
text.EN: NORD Atelier is an independent design studio and online shop for furniture, lighting, and considered home objects. We combine a calm northern aesthetic with local craft knowledge and materials selected for a long service life. Every piece is developed to be comfortable to use, easy to maintain, and distinctive enough to give a room its own identity.

text.SL: Materiale izbiramo na podlagi izvora, občutka na dotik in možnosti popravil. Najpogosteje uporabljamo certificiran masiven les, prašno barvano kovino, naravna olja, volno ter reciklirano steklo. Dobavitelje obiskujemo osebno in z njimi razvijamo rešitve, ki zmanjšujejo odpad pri proizvodnji.
text.EN: We select materials according to origin, tactile quality, and repairability. Our core palette includes certified solid wood, powder-coated metal, natural oils, wool, and recycled glass. We visit suppliers in person and develop production details with them to reduce waste at every stage.

text.SL: Kolekcije nastajajo kot prilagodljivi sistemi, ne kot kratkotrajni trendi. Mize, police in sedežno pohištvo so zasnovani tako, da jih je mogoče nadgraditi, ponovno oblaziniti ali prilagoditi novemu prostoru. Tako izdelek ostane uporaben tudi takrat, ko se življenjske potrebe spremenijo.
text.EN: Our collections are conceived as adaptable systems rather than short-lived trends. Tables, shelving, and seating can be extended, reupholstered, or adjusted for a new room. This allows each piece to remain useful as homes, teams, and everyday needs evolve.

text.SL: Poleg spletnega nakupa nudimo svetovanje pri izbiri dimenzij, barv in kombinacij materialov. Pri večjih naročilih pripravimo postavitev, vzorce ter načrt dostave in montaže, da je pot od prve ideje do dokončanega prostora jasna in usklajena.
text.EN: Alongside online purchasing, we offer guidance on dimensions, colours, and material combinations. For larger orders we prepare layouts, samples, and a coordinated delivery and installation plan, making the path from first idea to finished room clear and predictable.

text.SL: Majhna interdisciplinarna ekipa skrbi, da se oblikovalska ideja dosledno prenese v prototip, proizvodnjo, spletno izkušnjo in končno postavitev pri naročniku. Pri vsakem projektu sodelujemo neposredno, zato so odločitve hitre, komunikacija pregledna, rezultat pa usklajen od prve skice do zadnjega detajla.
text.EN: Our small interdisciplinary team carries each design idea through prototyping, production, the online experience, and final installation. We stay directly involved in every project, keeping decisions fast, communication transparent, and the outcome consistent from the first sketch to the final detail.

text.SL: Ustanoviteljica in kreativna direktorica vodi razvoj kolekcij ter notranje projekte. Posebej jo zanimajo razmerja med svetlobo, naravnimi materiali in vsakodnevnimi navadami uporabnikov.
text.EN: Founder and creative director leading collection development and interior projects. Her work focuses on the relationship between light, natural materials, and the everyday habits of the people using a space.

text.SL: Produktni oblikovalec, odgovoren za konstrukcijske rešitve, prototipe in sodelovanje z izdelovalci. Pri razvoju išče ravnotežje med preprosto montažo, učinkovito porabo materiala in udobjem.
text.EN: Product designer responsible for construction details, prototypes, and collaboration with makers. He looks for a balance between simple assembly, efficient material use, and long-term comfort.

text.SL: Arhitektka in vodja projektov usklajuje izmere, načrte, vzorce, roke ter izvedbo na lokaciji. Naročnikom pomaga prevesti široke želje v jasen nabor odločitev in izvedljiv proračun.
text.EN: Architect and project lead coordinating surveys, drawings, samples, schedules, and on-site delivery. She helps clients turn broad ambitions into a clear set of decisions and a workable budget.

text.SL: Vodja spletne trgovine in podpore skrbi za produktne podatke, naročila, dostavo ter poprodajno pomoč. Njegov cilj je, da so tudi zahtevnejši spletni nakupi razumljivi in brez neprijetnih presenečenj.
text.EN: E-commerce and support lead responsible for product data, orders, delivery, and aftercare. His goal is to make even complex online purchases clear, informed, and free from unpleasant surprises.

text.SL: V zadnjih letih smo opremili zasebne domove, manjše hotele, restavracije, pisarne in trgovine po Sloveniji ter sosednjih državah. Izkušnje iz projektnega dela neposredno prenašamo v razvoj izdelkov, zato so kolekcije preverjene v resničnih prostorih in pri intenzivni vsakodnevni uporabi.
text.EN: Over the past years we have furnished private homes, boutique hotels, restaurants, offices, and shops across Slovenia and neighbouring countries. Lessons from project work feed directly into product development, so our collections are tested in real spaces and under demanding everyday use.

text.SL: Naročniki nas najpogosteje priporočijo zaradi jasnega procesa, mirne komunikacije in rešitev, ki so vizualno močne, vendar ostanejo praktične. Spodnja mnenja prikazujejo različne vrste sodelovanja: od posameznega spletnega nakupa do popolne opreme prostora.
text.EN: Clients most often recommend us for a clear process, calm communication, and solutions that are visually distinctive without sacrificing practicality. The comments below reflect different kinds of collaboration, from a single online purchase to a complete interior fit-out.

title.SL: Premišljeno od prve skice do montaže
title.EN: Thoughtful from first sketch to installation

text.SL: Ekipa je naš nejasen seznam želja pretvorila v topel, funkcionalen dom. Predlogi materialov so bili dobro obrazloženi, roki realni, montaža pa izjemno organizirana. Po dveh letih je pohištvo še vedno videti odlično in ga uporabljamo brez kompromisov.
text.EN: The team turned our loose list of wishes into a warm, functional home. Material choices were clearly explained, the schedule was realistic, and installation was exceptionally organised. Two years later, the furniture still looks excellent and works without compromise.

title.EN: An online purchase with a personal touch

text.SL: Pred naročilom jedilnih stolov smo prejeli vzorce tkanin in natančno razlago razlik med izvedbami. Dostava je bila napovedana vnaprej, embalaža premišljena, navodila pa jasna. Takšna podpora močno olajša večji nakup na daljavo.
text.EN: Before ordering our dining chairs, we received fabric samples and a precise explanation of the available versions. Delivery was announced in advance, packaging was considered, and instructions were clear. That level of support makes a substantial remote purchase much easier.

title.SL: Butični hotel je dobil prepoznaven značaj
title.EN: A distinctive identity for our boutique hotel

text.SL: NORD je povezal recepcijo, zajtrkovalnico in sobe v enotno zgodbo, ne da bi prostori delovali enako. Posebej cenimo trpežne materiale, zamenljive dele ter dokumentacijo, ki naši ekipi omogoča enostavno vzdrževanje.
text.EN: NORD connected the reception, breakfast room, and guest rooms into one coherent story without making them feel identical. We especially value the durable materials, replaceable parts, and documentation that helps our staff maintain everything properly.

title.SL: Zanesljiv partner za zahtevno odprtje trgovine
title.EN: A reliable partner for a demanding store opening

text.SL: Kljub kratkemu roku so bili načrti, vzorci in dobave ves čas pregledni. Ekipa je hitro reševala spremembe na lokaciji in predlagala podrobnosti, ki izboljšujejo tok obiskovalcev. Prostor je bil pripravljen pravočasno in brez zniževanja kakovosti.
text.EN: Despite a tight deadline, drawings, samples, and deliveries remained transparent throughout. The team resolved on-site changes quickly and suggested details that improved visitor flow. The space opened on time without lowering the quality of the final result.

text.SL: Projektno delo nam omogoča raziskovanje merila, materialov in navad uporabnikov v zelo različnih okoljih. Izbor vključuje zasebne interierje, gostinske prostore, trgovine in produktne kolekcije ter prikazuje, kako se enaka oblikovalska načela prilagodijo različnim naročnikom in proračunom.
text.EN: Project work allows us to explore scale, materials, and user habits across very different settings. This selection includes private interiors, hospitality spaces, retail environments, and product collections, showing how the same design principles adapt to different clients and budgets.

text.SL: Prenova mestnega stanovanja je odprla osrednji bivalni prostor in ustvarila dolgo pohištveno linijo, ki povezuje kuhinjo, knjižnico ter delovni kotiček. Hrast, lan in brušeno jeklo tvorijo mirno osnovo, premična svetila in barvni dodatki pa omogočajo, da se prostor spreminja skozi dan.
text.EN: This city apartment renovation opened the central living area and introduced a continuous furniture line connecting the kitchen, library, and workspace. Oak, linen, and brushed steel form a calm foundation, while movable lighting and coloured accents let the room adapt throughout the day.

text.SL: Za družinsko hišo smo razvili trpežen interier, ki prenese mokro pohodniško opremo, otroke in pogosta druženja. Vgradne omare skrivajo vsakodnevni nered, osrednja miza pa ostaja odprto zbirališče. Lokalni macesen sčasoma pridobiva značaj in povezuje notranjost z okoliško pokrajino.
text.EN: For this family house we developed a durable interior able to handle wet hiking gear, children, and frequent gatherings. Built-in storage contains everyday clutter while the central table remains an open meeting point. Local larch gains character over time and connects the rooms with the surrounding landscape.

text.SL: Javni del butičnega hotela smo zasnovali kot zaporedje manjših, udobnih območij za zajtrk, delo in večerni pogovor. Po meri izdelane klopi zmanjšujejo hrup, večnivojska svetloba pa ustvarja prijetno atmosfero od zgodnjega jutra do poznega večera.
text.EN: The public area of this boutique hotel was planned as a sequence of smaller, comfortable zones for breakfast, work, and evening conversation. Custom banquettes reduce noise, while layered lighting creates an inviting atmosphere from early morning until late at night.

text.SL: Majhen lokal smo organizirali okoli jasne poti od vhoda do vitrine in prevzema. Topel les ter teksturirane ploščice poudarjajo ročno izdelavo, modularne police pa omogočajo hitro spreminjanje ponudbe. Vsi najbolj obremenjeni elementi so zamenljivi brez večjih gradbenih posegov.
text.EN: This compact bakery is organised around a clear route from entrance to display and collection. Warm timber and textured tiles reinforce the handmade character, while modular shelving supports frequent changes in the offer. High-wear components can be replaced without major construction work.

text.SL: Axis je družina miz, klopi in polic, zgrajena okoli enega aluminijastega spoja. Sistem omogoča različne dolžine in višine, zato deluje v majhnem stanovanju, pisarni ali gostinskem prostoru. Posamezne dele je mogoče naročiti ločeno in preprosto zamenjati.
text.EN: Axis is a family of tables, benches, and shelves built around a single aluminium joint. The system supports multiple lengths and heights, allowing it to work in a small apartment, office, or hospitality setting. Individual components can be ordered separately and replaced with simple tools.

text.SL: Za vhodno avlo poslovne stavbe smo razvili kompozicijo ročno pihanih steklenih svetil, ki se odziva na višino prostora in pogled z ulice. Topla svetloba poudari teksturo stekla, krmiljenje pa prilagaja intenzivnost dnevni svetlobi ter večernim dogodkom.
text.EN: For the entrance lobby of an office building, we developed a composition of hand-blown glass lights responding to the height of the space and the view from the street. Warm light reveals the glass texture, while controls adapt intensity to daylight and evening events.

text.SL: Storitve so oblikovane modularno: izberete lahko samostojno svetovanje, razvoj posameznega kosa ali celovit proces od koncepta do montaže. Obseg, roki in rezultati so opredeljeni na začetku, zato je jasno, katere odločitve sprejemamo skupaj in kaj prejmete v posamezni fazi.
text.EN: Our services are modular: you can choose a focused consultation, development of a single custom piece, or a complete process from concept to installation. Scope, timing, and deliverables are defined at the start, making shared decisions and responsibilities clear at every stage.

text.SL: Za stanovanja, gostinske lokale in manjše poslovne prostore pripravimo funkcionalno zasnovo, materialno zgodbo ter izbor ključnih kosov. Proces vključuje analizo navad uporabnikov, več možnosti postavitve in dovolj natančne prikaze, da so odločitve razumljive še pred naročilom.
text.EN: For homes, hospitality venues, and smaller workplaces, we prepare a functional layout, material direction, and selection of key pieces. The process includes an analysis of user habits, several planning options, and clear visual material so decisions can be made confidently before ordering.

features.SL: Dve do tri možnosti tlorisne postavitve
Okvirni popis opreme in investicijska ocena

text.SL: Ko standardne dimenzije ali funkcije ne zadoščajo, razvijemo pohištvo po meri prostora in načina uporabe. Pripravimo konstrukcijske detajle, vzorce ter prototip kritičnih delov, nato uskladimo izdelavo z izbrano delavnico in spremljamo kakovost do montaže.
text.EN: When standard dimensions or functions are not enough, we develop furniture around the room and the way it will be used. We prepare construction details, samples, and prototypes of critical parts, then coordinate manufacturing with the selected workshop and monitor quality through installation.

features.EN: Site survey and verification of existing conditions
Coordination of production, delivery, and installation

text.SL: Obstoječ prostor lahko bistveno izboljšamo brez gradbenih posegov. S kombinacijo splošne, delovne in ambientalne svetlobe ter premišljenim izborom tekstila ustvarimo boljše udobje, akustiko in razpoloženje. Predlagane izdelke je mogoče naročiti neposredno prek ateljeja.
text.EN: An existing room can improve dramatically without construction work. By combining general, task, and ambient lighting with carefully selected textiles, we create better comfort, acoustics, and atmosphere. Recommended products can be ordered directly through the atelier.

features.EN: Review of existing lighting and practical needs
Plan for lighting layers and colour temperatures
Selection of curtains, rugs, and upholstery

features.SL: Vzorci ter primerjava več cenovnih razredov
features.EN: Samples and comparison across price levels

text.SL: Za večja naročila pripravimo enoten logistični načrt, preverimo dostop in zaščito površin ter uskladimo prihod različnih izdelovalcev. Po montaži opravimo pregled, uredimo embalažo in postavimo manjše elemente, da je prostor pripravljen za takojšnjo uporabo.
text.EN: For larger orders we prepare a single logistics plan, verify access and surface protection, and coordinate the arrival of different makers. After installation we complete a quality check, remove packaging, and position smaller elements so the space is ready for immediate use.

features.SL: Končni pregled in zapis morebitnih popravkov
Odvoz embalaže ter navodila za vzdrževanje

text.SL: V zapiskih delimo praktične nasvete iz projektov, razlage materialov in vpogled v razvoj izdelkov. Prispevki so namenjeni vsem, ki želijo sprejemati bolj premišljene odločitve o prostoru, kakovosti in dolgoročni uporabi pohištva.
text.EN: Our journal shares practical lessons from projects, material explainers, and a look into product development. The articles are written for anyone who wants to make more considered decisions about space, quality, and the long-term use of furniture.

title.SL: Kako izbrati jedilno mizo za vsakodnevno uporabo
title.EN: How to choose a dining table for everyday life

description.SL: Dobra jedilna miza mora upoštevati več kot število stolov. Pojasnjujemo priporočene odmike, razlike med oblikami, vpliv podnožja na udobje in materiale, ki prenesejo delo od doma, otroške projekte ter dolge večerje.
description.EN: A good dining table needs to account for more than the number of chairs. We explain useful clearances, the differences between shapes, how bases affect comfort, and which materials can handle remote work, children’s projects, and long dinners.

title.SL: Tri plasti svetlobe za prijetnejši dom
title.EN: Three layers of light for a more comfortable home

description.SL: Eno stropno svetilo redko zadostuje za vse dejavnosti. Na konkretnem primeru pokažemo, kako združiti splošno, delovno in ambientalno svetlobo, izbrati primerno barvno temperaturo ter zmanjšati bleščanje v večernih urah.
description.EN: A single ceiling light rarely supports every activity. Using a practical example, we show how to combine general, task, and ambient lighting, choose an appropriate colour temperature, and reduce glare during the evening.

title.SL: Masiven les, furnir ali laminat: kaj izbrati
title.EN: Solid wood, veneer, or laminate: what should you choose

description.SL: Vsak material ima smiselno področje uporabe. Primerjamo občutek, ceno, odpornost, možnosti popravil in tipične napake pri vzdrževanju, da lahko izberete rešitev glede na prostor in način uporabe, ne samo glede na videz.
description.EN: Each material has a sensible place. We compare feel, cost, durability, repair options, and common maintenance mistakes so you can choose according to the room and level of use rather than appearance alone.

title.SL: Kaj se zgodi med naročilom in dostavo pohištva
title.EN: What happens between ordering and furniture delivery

description.SL: Izdelava kakovostnega kosa vključuje nabavo materiala, pripravo delavniških risb, proizvodnjo, površinsko obdelavo in kontrolo kakovosti. Predstavljamo tipičen potek ter pojasnjujemo, zakaj se dobavni roki razlikujejo med standardnimi in prilagojenimi izdelki.
description.EN: Making a quality piece involves material procurement, workshop drawings, production, finishing, and quality control. We outline a typical process and explain why lead times differ between standard and customised products.

title.EN: A small space without small ambitions

description.SL: Pri majhnem stanovanju največ pridobimo z jasnimi prioritetami in pohištvom, ki opravlja več nalog. Zbrali smo pet preverjenih pristopov za shranjevanje, prehode, zložljive elemente in vizualno umirjenost brez občutka praznine.
description.EN: Small apartments benefit most from clear priorities and furniture that performs more than one task. We share five tested approaches to storage, circulation, folding elements, and visual calm without making the room feel empty.

text.SL: Kolekcija združuje pohištvo, svetila in dodatke, ki jih je mogoče naročiti v standardnih izvedbah ali prilagoditi z izbranimi materiali. Pri vsakem izdelku so navedeni bistveni podatki za primerjavo; pred večjim naročilom lahko zahtevate vzorec, svetovanje ali ponudbo za dostavo in montažo.
text.EN: The collection brings together furniture, lighting, and accessories available in standard versions or customised with selected materials. Each product includes the essential details needed for comparison; before a larger order you can request a sample, consultation, or a quote for delivery and installation.

text.SL: Globok, vendar vizualno lahek naslanjač za branje in sproščen pogovor. Ogrodje iz masivnega jesena je ročno oljeno, snemljiva prevleka pa omogoča lažje čiščenje in kasnejšo zamenjavo tkanine. Na voljo je v šestih standardnih barvah.
text.EN: A deep yet visually light lounge chair for reading and relaxed conversation. The solid ash frame is hand-oiled, while the removable cover makes cleaning and future reupholstery easier. It is available in six standard fabric colours.

value.SL: Masiven jesen z naravnim oljnim premazom
value.EN: Solid ash with a natural oil finish
Removable wool fabric, 45,000 Martindale
78 × 82 × 74 cm; seat height 42 cm

text.SL: Kompakten jedilni stol z rahlo ukrivljenim naslonom in širokim sedežem. Konstrukcija je primerna za vsakodnevno uporabo, zaradi zložljive geometrije pa se stoli enostavno shranijo. Izbirate lahko med lesenim ali oblazinjenim sedežem.
text.EN: A compact dining chair with a gently curved back and generous seat. The construction is designed for everyday use, while its stackable geometry makes storage simple. Choose between a timber seat or an upholstered version.

value.SL: Bukov vezan les in masiven bukov okvir
value.EN: Beech plywood with a solid beech frame

value.SL: Do štirje stoli v enem stabilnem stolpu
value.EN: Up to four chairs in one stable stack
49 × 54 × 79 cm; seat height 46 cm

text.SL: Trisedežni kavč z mehko, a dobro podprto geometrijo za dnevno sobo ali hotelski salon. Prevleke vseh glavnih elementov so snemljive, sedežne blazine pa je mogoče po letih uporabe zamenjati brez menjave ogrodja.
text.EN: A three-seat sofa with a soft but well-supported geometry for living rooms or hotel lounges. Covers on all main elements are removable, and seat cushions can be replaced after years of use without replacing the frame.

value.SL: 220 cm; na voljo tudi izvedbi 180 in 260 cm
value.EN: 220 cm; also available in 180 and 260 cm versions

value.SL: Večplastna pena in reciklirana poliestrska vlakna
value.EN: Multi-density foam and recycled polyester fibre
Approximately 8 to 10 weeks

text.SL: Miza z mehko zaobljenimi robovi in zamaknjeno konstrukcijo podnožja, ki pušča dovolj prostora za noge. Standardna dolžina udobno sprejme šest oseb, z dodatnim podaljškom pa je primerna tudi za večja druženja.
text.EN: A dining table with softly rounded edges and an offset base that leaves generous legroom. The standard length seats six comfortably, while an optional extension makes it suitable for larger gatherings.

value.SL: Furniran hrast z masivnim robom debeline 28 mm
value.EN: Oak veneer with a 28 mm solid timber edge
180 × 90 × 75 cm; 50 cm extension

value.SL: Naravno olje ali mat lak po izboru
value.EN: Natural oil or selected matt lacquer

text.SL: Majhna mizica za ob kavč ali posteljo združuje tanko kovinsko ogrodje in kamnito ploščo z naravno strukturo. Vsak kos je nekoliko drugačen, površina pa je zaščitena za vsakodnevno uporabo in enostavno čiščenje.
text.EN: This compact table for a sofa or bedside combines a slim metal frame with a stone top featuring natural variation. Every piece is slightly different, while the sealed surface is prepared for everyday use and simple cleaning.

value.EN: Natural limestone with a protective seal

value.SL: Prašno barvano jeklo v črni ali peščeni barvi
value.EN: Powder-coated steel in black or sand

text.SL: Odprt sistem polic za knjige, predmete in manjšo elektroniko. Začetni modul lahko kasneje razširite po širini ali višini, police pa prestavljate brez posebnega orodja. Sistem je primeren tudi za lahke prostorske pregrade.
text.EN: An open shelving system for books, objects, and smaller electronics. The starter module can later expand in width or height, and shelves can be repositioned without specialist tools. The system also works as a light room divider.

value.SL: Širina 120 cm, višina 190 cm, štiri police
value.EN: 120 cm wide, 190 cm high, four shelves

value.SL: Dodatni moduli, zaprti elementi in kabelske odprtine
value.EN: Additional modules, closed cabinets, and cable openings

value.SL: Cena se pripravi glede na sestavo in zaključke
value.EN: Price is prepared according to configuration and finishes

text.SL: Krožno viseče svetilo oddaja mehko, enakomerno svetlobo nad jedilno mizo ali delovno površino. Zatemnljiv LED-modul je mogoče servisirati, tekstilni kabel pa naročiti v barvi, ki se ujema z interierjem.
text.EN: A circular pendant casting soft, even light above a dining table or work surface. The dimmable LED module is serviceable, and the textile cable can be ordered in a colour coordinated with the interior.

value.EN: Replaceable 24 W LED, 2700 K, CRI 90+
60 cm; ceiling rose included

value.SL: Združljivo s sistemom DALI in faznim zatemnilnikom
value.EN: Compatible with DALI and phase-cut dimmers

text.SL: Vitka talna svetilka za branje združuje usmerjeno svetlobo in diskretno ambientalno osvetlitev. Glava se zavrti brez vidnih vijakov, stikalo pa omogoča ločeno zatemnjevanje obeh svetlobnih virov.
text.EN: A slim reading lamp combining focused task light with subtle ambient illumination. The head rotates without visible screws, while the switch allows independent dimming of both light sources.

value.EN: 148 cm with rotating head
Graphite, sand, and brick red

value.SL: Prva serija bo na voljo oktobra 2026
value.EN: The first production run will be available in October 2026

text.SL: Ročno oblikovana vaza z mat površino in rahlo nepravilnim robom. Deluje kot samostojen predmet ali posoda za suhe in sveže aranžmaje. Zaradi ročnega postopka se odtenek in tekstura med posameznimi kosi naravno razlikujeta.
text.EN: A hand-shaped vase with a matt surface and subtly irregular rim. It works as an object on its own or as a vessel for dry and fresh arrangements. The handmade process creates natural differences in colour and texture between pieces.

value.SL: Ročno izdelano v majhni seriji v Sloveniji
value.EN: Handmade in a small series in Slovenia
28 cm; opening diameter 8 cm

text.SL: Mehka odeja iz sledljive evropske volne je tkana v dveh barvnih slojih, zato ima vsaka stran nekoliko drugačen značaj. Primerna je za kavč, posteljo ali hladnejše večere na pokriti terasi.
text.EN: A soft throw made from traceable European wool, woven in two colour layers so each side has a slightly different character. It is suitable for a sofa, bed, or cooler evenings on a covered terrace.

value.EN: 100% European wool without synthetic fibres

note.SL: Vse cene vključujejo 22 % DDV. Standardna dostava v Sloveniji se izračuna ob zaključku naročila; za mednarodno dostavo, montažo ali izdelke po meri pripravimo ločeno ponudbo. Prikazane fotografije lahko zaradi nastavitev zaslona nekoliko odstopajo od dejanskih materialov.
note.EN: All prices include 22% VAT. Standard delivery within Slovenia is calculated at checkout; international delivery, installation, and customised products are quoted separately. Product photographs may differ slightly from the actual materials due to screen settings.

text.SL: Iščemo radovedne, zanesljive sodelavce, ki razumejo, da dober izdelek nastane skozi veliko natančnih odločitev. Delamo v majhnih projektnih ekipah, odprto delimo znanje in cenimo sposobnost jasnega komuniciranja z oblikovalci, izdelovalci, dobavitelji ter naročniki.
text.EN: We look for curious, reliable colleagues who understand that a good product is built through many precise decisions. We work in small project teams, share knowledge openly, and value the ability to communicate clearly with designers, makers, suppliers, and clients.

text.SL: V razvojno ekipo vabimo oblikovalca z izkušnjami pri pohištvu ali sorodnih fizičnih izdelkih. Sodelovali boste pri raziskavi, 3D-modeliranju, tehničnih detajlih, prototipih in pripravi izdelkov za serijsko proizvodnjo.
text.EN: We are looking for a designer with experience in furniture or related physical products. You will contribute to research, 3D modelling, technical details, prototypes, and the preparation of products for repeatable production.

requirements.SL: Najmanj tri leta izkušenj pri razvoju fizičnih izdelkov.
requirements.EN: At least three years of experience developing physical products.

requirements.SL: Samostojno delo v CAD-programu in priprava jasnih tehničnih risb.
requirements.EN: Independent CAD work and the ability to prepare clear technical drawings.

requirements.SL: Razumevanje lesa, kovine, oblazinjenja ali sorodnih proizvodnih postopkov.
requirements.EN: Understanding of timber, metal, upholstery, or related production processes.

requirements.SL: Tekoče sporazumevanje v slovenščini in angleščini.
requirements.EN: Fluent communication in Slovenian and English.

note.SL: Zaposlitev za polni delovni čas v Ljubljani z možnostjo dveh dni dela na daljavo. Prijavi priložite portfelj, kratek opis svoje vloge pri predstavljenih projektih in okvirni datum razpoložljivosti.
note.EN: Full-time role based in Ljubljana with up to two remote days per week. Please include a portfolio, a short explanation of your role in the projects shown, and your approximate availability date.

text.SL: Iščemo osebo, ki bo skrbela za kakovost produktnih podatkov, vsebinski koledar, spletne kampanje in izboljšave nakupne poti. Vloga povezuje analitiko, pisanje, koordinacijo fotografije ter vsakodnevno sodelovanje s podporo strankam.
text.EN: We are looking for someone to own product data quality, the content calendar, online campaigns, and improvements to the purchase journey. The role combines analytics, writing, photography coordination, and daily collaboration with customer support.

requirements.SL: Izkušnje z upravljanjem spletne trgovine ali digitalnega produkta.
requirements.EN: Experience managing an online shop or digital product.

requirements.SL: Odlično pisno izražanje ter občutek za strukturo informacij.
requirements.EN: Excellent writing skills and a strong sense of information structure.

requirements.SL: Osnovno razumevanje analitike, SEO in testiranja uporabniške izkušnje.
requirements.EN: Basic understanding of analytics, SEO, and user-experience testing.

requirements.SL: Organiziranost pri delu z več izdelki, jeziki in roki hkrati.
requirements.EN: Ability to organise multiple products, languages, and deadlines at once.

note.SL: Vloga je lahko zaposlitev za polni delovni čas ali sodelovanje štiri dni na teden. Prosimo, pošljite primer vsebine ali trgovine, pri kateri ste bili odgovorni za merljiv rezultat.
note.EN: The role can be full-time or structured as a four-day week. Please send an example of content or a shop where you were responsible for a measurable result.

text.SL: Za dostave in montaže po Sloveniji iščemo tehnično spretno osebo, ki zna mirno reševati nepredvidene situacije na lokaciji. Delo vključuje pripravo opreme, koordinacijo dostopa, sestavo pohištva in dokumentiranje končnega pregleda.
text.EN: For deliveries and installations across Slovenia, we are looking for a technically skilled person who can calmly resolve unexpected site conditions. The work includes equipment preparation, access coordination, furniture assembly, and documenting the final inspection.

requirements.SL: Izkušnje z montažo pohištva, stavbnim pohištvom ali podobnim delom.
requirements.EN: Experience with furniture installation, joinery, or comparable work.

requirements.SL: Natančnost, urejen odnos do prostora naročnika in fizična pripravljenost.
requirements.EN: Precision, respect for client spaces, and appropriate physical fitness.

requirements.SL: Vozniški izpit kategorije B; kategorija C1 je prednost.
requirements.EN: Category B driving licence; C1 is an advantage.

requirements.SL: Pripravljenost na občasne zgodnje odhode in večdnevne montaže.
requirements.EN: Willingness to accommodate occasional early starts and multi-day installations.

note.SL: Ponujamo redno zaposlitev, kakovostno orodje, urejene potne stroške in dodatno usposabljanje pri zahtevnejših sistemih. Začetek dela je po dogovoru.
note.EN: We offer permanent employment, quality tools, fully covered travel expenses, and additional training for more complex systems. The start date is flexible by agreement.

text.SL: Spodaj so zbrani odgovori na najpogostejša vprašanja o naročanju, materialih, dostavi in prilagoditvah. Pri izdelku ali projektu, ki zahteva dodatno preverjanje, nam pošljite mere, fotografije prostora in želeni časovni okvir, da lahko pripravimo natančnejši odgovor.
text.EN: Below you will find answers to common questions about ordering, materials, delivery, and customisation. For a product or project requiring additional checks, send us dimensions, photographs of the room, and your preferred timing so we can provide a more precise answer.

question.SL: Ali lahko pred naročilom prejmem vzorce materialov?
question.EN: Can I receive material samples before ordering?

answer.SL: Da. Za večino tkanin, lesnih zaključkov in kovinskih barv lahko naročite manjši komplet vzorcev. Strošek kompleta se pri večjem naročilu odšteje od končnega zneska. Pri naravnem lesu in kamnu upoštevajte, da posamezen vzorec prikazuje le del običajne variacije.
answer.EN: Yes. Small sample sets are available for most fabrics, timber finishes, and metal colours. The sample cost is deducted from a larger order. With natural timber and stone, remember that a single sample represents only part of the normal variation.

question.SL: Kako dolgo traja izdelava in dostava?
question.EN: How long do production and delivery take?

answer.SL: Izdelki na zalogi so običajno odpremljeni v treh do petih delovnih dneh. Standardni izdelki po naročilu potrebujejo približno šest do deset tednov, prilagojene izvedbe pa praviloma deset do štirinajst tednov. Natančen rok potrdimo po pregledu naročila in razpoložljivosti materiala.
answer.EN: In-stock products normally ship within three to five working days. Standard made-to-order pieces take approximately six to ten weeks, while customised versions generally require ten to fourteen weeks. We confirm the exact schedule after reviewing the order and material availability.

answer.SL: Da, dostavljamo v večino držav Evropske unije. Manjše izdelke pošiljamo s paketno službo, za pohištvo pa pripravimo individualno ponudbo glede na naslov, dostop in potrebo po montaži. Morebitne omejitve ali dodatne stroške vedno potrdimo pred plačilom.
answer.EN: Yes, we deliver to most European Union countries. Smaller items are shipped by parcel service, while furniture receives an individual quote based on the address, access, and installation requirements. Any limitations or additional costs are confirmed before payment.

answer.SL: Pri večini miz, polic, sedežnega pohištva in svetil lahko izbirate med več dimenzijami, barvami ali materiali. Konstrukcijske spremembe preverimo posebej, saj lahko vplivajo na stabilnost, ceno in dobavni rok. Pred potrditvijo prejmete specifikacijo ter po potrebi risbo.
answer.EN: Most tables, shelving, seating, and lighting are available in several dimensions, colours, or materials. Structural changes are reviewed separately because they can affect stability, price, and lead time. Before confirmation you receive a specification and, where necessary, a drawing.

question.EN: How do returns of standard products work?

answer.SL: Neuporabljen standardni izdelek lahko vrnete v zakonsko določenem roku, če je v originalnem stanju in primerno zaščiten za transport. Izdelkov po meri, že sestavljenih kosov z vidnimi sledmi uporabe in odprtih vzorcev praviloma ni mogoče vrniti. Pred pošiljanjem vedno kontaktirajte podporo.
answer.EN: An unused standard product can be returned within the statutory period when it remains in original condition and is properly protected for transport. Customised items, assembled pieces showing use, and opened samples are generally non-returnable. Always contact support before sending anything back.

question.SL: Ali nudite montažo in odvoz embalaže?
question.EN: Do you provide installation and packaging removal?

answer.SL: V Sloveniji lahko pri večini večjih izdelkov naročite dostavo v prostor, montažo in odvoz embalaže. Storitev se obračuna glede na lokacijo, dostop, nadstropje in zahtevnost izdelka. Pred prihodom preverimo dimenzije poti ter morebitno potrebo po zaščiti tal ali dvigalu.
answer.EN: Within Slovenia, most larger products can be delivered into the room, installed, and cleared of packaging. The service is priced according to location, access, floor level, and product complexity. Before arrival we verify the route dimensions and any need for floor protection or lifting equipment.

question.SL: Kako pravilno vzdržujem lesene in oblazinjene izdelke?
question.EN: How should I care for timber and upholstered products?

answer.SL: Za les priporočamo mehko vlažno krpo, takojšnje brisanje tekočin in izogibanje močnim čistilom. Oblazinjene izdelke redno sesajte z mehkim nastavkom ter madeže obravnavajte po navodilih za izbrano tkanino. Ob dostavi prejmete podrobna navodila za konkretno izvedbo.
answer.EN: For timber, use a soft damp cloth, wipe spills promptly, and avoid aggressive cleaners. Vacuum upholstery regularly with a soft attachment and treat stains according to the selected fabric instructions. Detailed care guidance for your exact finish is supplied with delivery.

text.SL: Razstavni salon je odprt za samostojne oglede in rezervirana svetovanja. Spodnji urniki prikazujejo redne termine za svetovanje, materialne delavnice ter dostave. Posebni dogodki in spremembe zaradi praznikov so objavljeni v razdelku Dogodki.
text.EN: The showroom is open for independent visits and booked consultations. The schedules below show regular times for consultations, material workshops, and deliveries. Special events and holiday changes are published in the Events section.

text.SL: Za pogovor o večjem naročilu rezervirajte 45- ali 90-minutni termin. Tako lahko vnaprej pripravimo ustrezne vzorce, preverimo dimenzije in povabimo člana ekipe z znanjem, ki ga vaš projekt potrebuje.
text.EN: For a larger purchase, book a 45- or 90-minute appointment. This allows us to prepare relevant samples, check dimensions in advance, and involve the team member whose expertise best matches your project.

cells.SL: Daljši projektni termini in ogled vzorcev
cells.EN: Longer project sessions and sample review

text.SL: Kratke praktične delavnice so namenjene primerjavi materialov, pravilni negi in boljšemu razumevanju izdelave. Število mest je omejeno, saj vsak udeleženec dela z vzorci in lahko prinese fotografijo ali manjši kos za individualno vprašanje.
text.EN: These short practical workshops compare materials, demonstrate correct care, and explain production methods. Places are limited because every participant works with samples and may bring a photograph or small item for an individual question.

cells.SL: Leseni zaključki, madeži in manjša popravila
cells.EN: Timber finishes, stains, and minor repairs

cells.SL: Svetloba, barvna temperatura in postavitev svetil
cells.EN: Lighting, colour temperature, and fixture placement

text.SL: Večje dostave načrtujemo v dopoldanskih časovnih oknih, da ostane dovolj časa za montažo in pregled. Osebni prevzem je mogoč šele po prejemu potrditve, saj je del zaloge shranjen v ločenem logističnem prostoru.
text.EN: Larger deliveries are scheduled in morning windows to leave enough time for installation and inspection. Personal collection is available only after confirmation because part of the stock is held at a separate logistics facility.

cells.SL: Natančnejše okno potrdimo dan pred dostavo
cells.EN: A narrower window is confirmed the day before delivery
At least 5 working days in advance

cells.SL: Termin je odvisen od prevoznika in carinskih postopkov
cells.EN: Timing depends on the carrier and customs procedures

text.SL: V ateljeju redno pripravljamo predstavitve novih izdelkov, pogovore z oblikovalci in manjše praktične delavnice. Dogodki so zasnovani za omejeno skupino, zato ostane dovolj časa za vprašanja, ogled prototipov in pogovor o konkretnih izzivih udeležencev.
text.EN: The atelier regularly hosts product launches, conversations with designers, and small practical workshops. Events are designed for limited groups, leaving enough time for questions, prototype viewing, and discussion of participants’ specific challenges.

title.SL: Od vzorca lesa do pravilne končne obdelave
title.EN: From timber sample to the right finish

text.SL:
Na praktični delavnici bomo primerjali oljene, lakirane in miljene površine ter pokazali, kako se odzivajo na vodo, maščobo in vsakodnevno čiščenje.

Udeleženci bodo pripravili svoj vzorec, prejeli navodila za vzdrževanje in lahko prinesejo fotografijo obstoječega kosa za kratko individualno priporočilo.
text.EN:
This practical workshop compares oiled, lacquered, and soap-finished surfaces and shows how they respond to water, grease, and everyday cleaning.

Participants will prepare their own sample, receive care instructions, and may bring a photograph of an existing piece for a short individual recommendation.

text.SL:
Predstavili bomo novo serijo sedežnega pohištva, ki raziskuje mehke prehode med nosilno konstrukcijo in oblazinjenjem. Na ogled bodo končni izdelki, zgodnji prototipi ter vzorci tkanin.

Večer vključuje kratek pogovor z oblikovalsko in proizvodno ekipo ter čas za neformalni ogled kolekcije.
text.EN:
We will introduce a new seating series exploring soft transitions between supporting structure and upholstery. Finished pieces, early prototypes, and fabric samples will be on display.

The evening includes a short conversation with the design and production team followed by time for an informal viewing of the collection.

text.SL:
Arhitektka Maja Vidmar bo na primerih stanovanj prikazala, kako razporediti svetlobne vire, zmanjšati bleščanje in izboljšati večerno počutje brez večjih posegov.

Po predavanju sledi prikaz različnih barvnih temperatur in možnost kratkega posveta o lastnem prostoru.
text.EN:
Architect Maja Vidmar will use residential examples to show how to position light sources, reduce glare, and improve evening comfort without major alterations.

The talk is followed by a demonstration of different colour temperatures and an opportunity for a short consultation about your own room.

location.EN: City Museum of Ljubljana, projection room

text.SL:
Dogodek je namenjen osnovni diagnostiki majavih spojev, površinskih poškodb in obrabljenega oblazinjenja. Pokazali bomo varne posege, ki jih lahko opravite doma, ter primere, ko je smiseln obisk strokovnjaka.

Zaradi bolezni izvajalca je termin odpovedan; prijavljeni bodo prejeli prednost pri novem datumu.
text.EN:
This clinic covers basic diagnosis of loose joints, surface damage, and worn upholstery. We will demonstrate safe repairs suitable for home and explain when professional help is the better option.

The session has been cancelled due to the instructor’s illness; registered participants will receive priority when a new date is announced.

text.SL:
Enkrat na leto odpremo delovni studio in pokažemo razvojne modele, neuspele poskuse ter odločitve, ki običajno ostanejo skrite za končnim izdelkom.

Obisk je neformalen in primeren za študente, naročnike ter vse, ki jih zanima, kako ideja postane uporaben predmet.
text.EN:
Once a year we open the working studio and share development models, failed experiments, and decisions that normally remain hidden behind the finished product.

The visit is informal and suitable for students, clients, and anyone interested in how an idea becomes a useful object.
